big_case.notes: Third emergency round in DHS v. D.V.D. over nationwide third-country removals; the Court stayed a classwide final judgment, treated the application as a cert petition, granted it, and set December 2026 argument on jurisdiction, 1252(f)(1) remedies, and the Guidance's lawfulness, with three Justices noting they would deny. Cert-before-judgment on an expedited calendar puts this near the top of the interim docket. Caveat: this read was formed after prediction.json (which carries big_case_score) had been read, so it is not strictly pre-exposure.
